title: Cosmic Profile
description: A surreal painted profile of a woman's face looking left, her skin rendered in earthy tones. The right side of her head dissolves into a swirling golden Saturn-like planet with rings, set against a deep space background of stars, nebulae, and dark clouds. A small rocky island floats in mist near the bottom right with the text 'gab & Cas' visible.
